facts.fact: Archie 把自己接到差事说成运气好，随即承认那从来不是运气，只是他夜里哄自己入睡的谎。
facts.anchor: It had never been luck, after all, whatever lies he told himself to sleep at night.

facts.fact: 这个位置是有人在背后拉线安排的，正如此前应许的那样。
facts.anchor: Strings had been pulled, just as they had promised.

facts.fact: Archie 用粤语朝窗边的影子发问：是来打招呼，还是等他睡着好割他的喉咙。
facts.anchor: “Are you going to say hello, or just slit my throat in my sleep?” he said in Cantonese

facts.fact: 进到房里的 Kiamling 掀了掀窗帘。
facts.anchor: Kiamling tweaked the curtain.

facts.fact: 她改用一把直剑，叫 kiam，正是她名字的来处。
facts.anchor: A straight sword instead, a kiam. Her namesake.

facts.fact: 她原来那把铜钱剑，是在她想刺他的时候断掉的。
facts.anchor: that had broken when she tried to stab him

facts.fact: 她不要解释，只要名字，声音硬得不像她。
facts.anchor: “I want names.” Her voice was hard

facts.fact: 他朝她转过头，说「吻我」。
facts.anchor: “Kiss me.” He turned his head towards her

facts.fact: 他告诉她不能吻他，因为这件事早就被他拿去做了交易。
facts.anchor: “You can’t kiss me, Kiamling, because I bargained it away.”

facts.fact: 他说最初那两段童年记忆被拿走，他连记都不记得。
facts.anchor: “I don’t even remember them taking the first couple of childhood memories.

facts.fact: 他一段又一段地给出去，最后只剩下母亲的失望和那些愤怒的对话。
facts.anchor: Until all I have left is my mother’s disappointment. The angry conversations at the end.”

facts.fact: 他连自己的抱负可能也一并交易掉了，而且不记得。
facts.anchor: “Perhaps I bargained away my ambition also. I don’t remember.

facts.fact: 他当猎犬那段时间只剩嘴里的铁味，和清醒过来时满身的伤。
facts.anchor: Only the taste of iron in my mouth, and my body bruised and battered when my senses returned.

facts.fact: 她由此得出结论：每一个吻都会是他的初吻。
facts.anchor: “Every kiss is your first kiss.”

facts.fact: 那瓶白兰地是他答应接下香港任务时别人送的，比他两个月的薪水还贵。
facts.anchor: A bottle of brandy he had been given when he had agreed to take on the Hong Kong mission.

facts.fact: 她拇指按在瓶口上，装出喝酒的样子。
facts.anchor: Kiamling had her thumb over the mouth of the bottle

facts.fact: 他口齿不清地问，自己的白兰地里为什么会有纸。
facts.anchor: “Why is there paper in my brandy?” he managed to say as his words slurred.

facts.fact: 瓶底有一只符纸折成的纸老虎，四只脚都用红线绑着。
facts.anchor: a paper tiger had been folded from a fu talisman. Its four feet tied up with red string.

facts.fact: 她说自己这是在扮猪捉虎。
facts.anchor: “I’m playing the pig to catch the tiger.”

facts.fact: 他心想这姑娘真聪明，随即又一次昏了过去。
facts.anchor: Clever girl. And with that, Archie once again blacked out.
